name: UncleCode Competitive Coding Agent Benchmark
methodology: Each system receives the same isolated fixture, prompt, model target, timeout, and deterministic post-run checks. Scores come from files and executable behavior, never self-reported answers.

tasks.description: Honor a repository-local instruction without touching unrelated input.
tasks.prompt: Complete the task defined by the repository instructions. Verify the result before finishing.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Benchmark instruction

For this benchmark only, create `result.txt` with the exact UTF-8 content `LOCAL_RULE_OK` followed by one newline. Do not modify any existing file.

tasks.description: Rename a public symbol across files without leaving an alias or stale callsite.
tasks.prompt: Rename the exported `sum` function to `add`, update every caller, leave no compatibility alias or stale `sum` identifier, and run the provided test.

files.app.mjs:
import { sum } from './math.mjs';

export const total = sum(20, 22);

tasks.description: Fix a Unicode correctness bug while preserving the existing ASCII contract.
tasks.prompt: Fix the slug implementation so the provided regression test passes. Preserve letters and decimal digits from every Unicode script, keep the ASCII behavior, add no dependency, and run the test.
